sample_views_fibonacci: sample 25 fibonacci-distributed camera views from a unit sphere with full azimuth and elevation range
sample_views_hinterstoisser: sample camera views from a sphere using icosahedron refinement with a specified minimum view count
fibonacci_sampling_points: sample an odd number of almost equidistant 3D points on a sphere using the Fibonacci lattice
hinter_sampling_points: sample 3D points on a sphere by iteratively refining an icosahedron mesh to a minimum point count
save_vis_ply: create a PLY file visualizing sampled camera views with colored axes and intensity-coded view levels
